messages:
sam: heads-up — customer support flagged sudden rise in "compatibility_score_drop" for v1 clients after we enabled strict header validation overnight. routing console shows lots of shadow-fallbacks to v2.
ana: saw it. shadow-fallbacks are from the new header-parser change (trim/normalize). some older SDKs send `X-Client-Version: v1.0` vs `v1` and our parser treats them differently.
michael: hmm parser normalization should be idempotent. did we change canonicalization rules?
tara: yes, change merged to normalize numeric suffixes; intended to reduce noise. but matching logic for legacy feature-flags didn't include the normalized form.
sam: consequence: compatibility score drops below threshold for many tenants and shadow routing marks them incompatible, increasing our preview fallback telemetry. support is getting noise.
jess: proposal: two-step mitigation — (1) revert strict canonicalization for 1 hour, (2) add a lenient-match pass where we accept both raw and normalized header values for compatibility scoring.
nana: agree. also want a console control to toggle "lenient-compat-mode" per tenant so we can opt-in conservative tenants while keeping stricter policy in beta. ops wants per-tenant control.
michael: backend change looks small: update scorer to OR on raw vs normalized header, and expose `compatibility.mode` with values `strict|lenient|shadow`. then routing-preview API can simulate each mode.
tara: UX/telemetry ask: rollout preview should show three columns: current, strict, lenient with sample percentage that would fallback. ops asked for confidence bands — e.g., 95th percentile estimate across last 5m.
anj: (bot typo)
sam: also add a "shadow only" column — keep traffic routing unchanged but emit shadow fallback traces so we can measure real impact without user facing changes. add sampling key `preview.shadow=true`.
jess: I'll implement scorer change + add per-tenant flag. ETA 2hrs. michael — can you add preview endpoint to demo the three-mode comparison?
michael: yes, I'll add POST /api/rollout/simulate that accepts tenant id + window and returns {current_rate, strict_rate, lenient_rate, shadow_impact}. It will tag traces with `preview.origin=simulator` so alerts ignore them.
nana: console UX: add a compact control on tenant page with radio: Strict | Lenient | Shadow-only, plus a small "simulate" button that calls the endpoint and renders the three columns with a sparkline. I'll write copy: "Lenient accepts minor header variants to reduce false positives during deprecations".
tara: telemetry: we should also create a synthetic metric `compat.false_positive_estimate` derived from shadow discrepancies to feed the deprecations dashboard.
sam: ops-bot: can you temporarily mute customer-facing deprecation banners for tenants that are set to Lenient or Shadow-only for the next 6 hours?
ops-bot: acknowledged. customer banners muted for tenants with flags: lenient|shadow for 6h.
nana: follow-ups: jess -> scorer patch + unit tests; michael -> simulate endpoint + ensure no alert bleed; tara -> add false_positive_estimate metric; sam -> coordinate muting and notify support. reconvene in 90m to review simulation results.
michael: will also add a safety circuit: if lenient mode causes >1% increase in incompatible calls (unexpected), auto-revert to strict for that tenant.
sam: thanks team. if simulation looks good we can promote lenient to the default for the broader cohort next week.
ops-bot: simulation job queued for tenant @alpha-cohort, window=5m.
sam: :thumbsup:
